_doc: Inline SVG art that is NOT one of the shared 24-grid toolbar glyphs, so it cannot ride in icons.json — every key THERE must resolve to an entry of the glyph table each surface builds (desktop iconSet.cpp) and to a hover design in iconMotion.json. Three pieces live here instead: `drawMode`, the draw-mode toggle's 16-grid Line/Rect pair (served by js/ui/icons.js), `favicon`, the app mark whose panel outline is painted in the live accent, and `secretEgg`, the mark a logo show's notice wears. browser/tests/svgArt.test.js pins the first two — the favicon against favicon.svg and the extension's copy in src/lib/accent.js, the pair against icons.json's canonical line/rect.

rules.drawMode: Complete <svg> strings, on a 16 grid at 13px. currentColor only, so they inherit the button's ink; class hooks are the canon's own (icons.json line/rect) so both faces play the canonical draw-on.
rules.favicon: A complete <svg> string with ONE placeholder, %1 — the accent hex the panel outline is stroked in. Everything else is fixed brand art (themeTokens.json `brand`).
rules.secretEgg: A complete <svg> string with three placeholders — %1 and %2 the pixel width and height, %3 the one colour it is painted in. The viewBox is cropped to the shell, so the mark fills its box instead of sitting in the 24-grid's margins. One evenodd path: the shell, then the bands and the dots carved out of it, so the surface behind shows through and the mark stays a single colour.

drawMode.line: <svg class="draw-mode-icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="13" height="13" aria-hidden="true"><line class="ic-stroke" x1="3" y1="13" x2="13" y2="3" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="ic-handle" cx="3" cy="13" r="2" fill="currentColor"/><circle class="ic-handle" cx="13" cy="3" r="2" fill="currentColor"/></svg>
drawMode.rect: <svg class="draw-mode-icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="13" height="13" aria-hidden="true"><rect class="ic-box" x="3" y="3" width="10" height="10" rx="1" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"/><circle class="ic-handle" cx="3" cy="13" r="2" fill="currentColor"/><circle class="ic-handle" cx="13" cy="3" r="2" fill="currentColor"/></svg>
